checks.name: XML well-formedness
checks.scope: XML syntax only; not WPF schema compilation

checks.name: C# outer delimiter balance
checks.scope: Comments/literals masked; interpolation internals skipped; not type checking or compilation

checks.name: XAML code-behind and declared events
checks.scope: Matching class names and handler method names; not delegate signature checking

checks.name: XAML resource and named-element references
checks.scope: Aggregate resource-key existence and per-file names; not runtime resource scope/binding validation

checks.name: Theme token parity
checks.scope: Light and dark token dictionaries declare the same keys

checks.name: Named test declarations
checks.scope: Declared test names only; no test has been executed by this validator

checks.name: Narrow source safety checks
checks.scope: No listed networking/shell/deserialization APIs in implementation; selected clipboard guards present. Not a security audit.

checks.name: Packaging exclusions and unfinished-code markers
checks.scope: No bundled font files or TODO/FIXME/NotImplementedException markers; not a completeness claim

checks.name: v0.2 data-loss and smoke isolation guards
checks.scope: Narrow reviewed call-site presence/absence checks only; does not execute storage, bootstrap or WPF code

checks.name: v0.3 competitor-gap source guards
checks.scope: Source-presence and reviewed shortcut-boundary guards for the v0.3 additions; not runtime validation

not_performed: PowerShell SDK bootstrap and packaging execution
limitations: Structural checks cannot establish buildability or runtime correctness.
Source safety checks do not constitute a security audit.
Use scripts/test.ps1, scripts/build.ps1 and docs/VALIDATION.md on Windows.
